plain: Ignoring law and morals; taking freedom too far.

webster.text: Using license; indulging freedom to excess; unrestrained by law or morality; loose; dissolute; as a licentious man.

example.quote: The licentious and wicked of the community will seize with avidity every thing you hold.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 24, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
